correctness.rationale: Independently replayed the full census. Enumeration: 512 binary 3x3 matrices reduce under simultaneous permutation to 104 canonical classes with orbit histogram 1:4, 3:28, 6:70, 2:2 summing to 512; representative sets match exactly. Exact invariants: recomputed characteristic polynomials (via trace/principal-minors/determinant), tr(A^k) k=1..6, zeta denominators det(I-tA) and series, all match stored rows with zero mismatches; 32 distinct charpolys and 32 distinct trace-sequences; cp<->trace bijection holds in-window. Zeta-trace identity -Q'=QT mod t^6 holds on all 104 classes in exact integer arithmetic. Spectral enclosures: split 93 reducible / 11 irreducible classes (9 distinct cubics) confirmed by exact integer-root test; rechecked every cubic bracket sign change p(lo)<0<p(hi) in Fractions, derivative-positivity min on bracket >0, D<0 side conditions (all 7 have c=-1 and lo>1, so r|z|^2=1 gives rho=r>1), D=49 largest-root conditions (vertex -a/3<=lo and p'(lo)>0) hold; reducible interval rows contain max(|lin|, quad roots) and point rows satisfy p(lo)=0 with all other roots' moduli <= lo via exact deflation (shared factors x^2-x-1 for golden ratio, x^2-2x-1 for 1+sqrt2 verified algebraically). Nilpotent group: all 6 rows have A^3=0 and zero traces, so h=0 finite-shift convention is explicit and sound. Value grouping: 18 groups with class counts summing to 104 and orbit sums to 512; row rho-intervals contained in group intervals; consecutive rho-enclosures disjoint with min positive rho-gap 6570508980253/175921860444160 ~=0.037349 (C:(-1,-2,1)->C:(-1,-1,-1)) and min positive h-gap ~=0.018601 (C:(-2,0,-1)->C:(-2,-1,1)), matching headline >0.037/>0.018. Extremal witnesses: J3 has chi=x^2(x-3), rho=3, tr=3^k; second-max matrix [[0,1,1],[1,1,1],[1,1,1]] has chi=x(x^2-2x-2), rho=1+sqrt3, traces (2,8,20,56,152,416), matching stored row. Log widths <1e-9 and rho widths <=2^-50 confirmed; spot-checked h-intervals contain log(mid). verify.py prints VERIFY_OK from workspace root. Result is proof via exact rational certificates, not mere numerics.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp/search alone. Classical background h=log(rho) and zeta=1/det(I-tA) (Lind-Marcus; Manning/Artin-Mazur) are explicitly disclaimed, not re-claimed. Nearest prior: (1) Lind-Marcus textbook gives general formulas only, no n=3 table; (2) Agarwal-Cheriyath-Tikekar (arXiv:2211.06068) gives general Perron/Parry formulas for multigraph edge shifts, no closed unlabelled 3-state census with enclosures/collisions; (3) Gohlke-Rust-Spindeler (arXiv:1712.05340) proves density of Perron entropies via random substitutions, an existence theorem, not a finite certified n=3 table; (4) Matsumoto (arXiv:1405.6443) treats Markov-Dyck (non-SFT) zeta, different class; (5) OEIS A000595 records only the count sequence 1,2,10,104,... confirming 104 is the natural scope, with no spectral radii, entropies, traces, or zeta coefficients. Live arXiv search for three-state SFT entropy census returns no results. The new artefact — 18 certified distinct entropy values, 32 charpoly/trace types, collision classes (rho=1: 45/6/6; rho=2: 18/6/6; golden ratio 16/3/3; 1+sqrt2 4/3/3), second-maximal value and minimal positive gaps — is not mechanically implied by the formula alone and appears in no source triaged.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural object meeting the exact-invariant clause: object (unlabelled 3x3 (0,1)-SFTs, 512->104 types) and invariants (topological entropy h=log rho, periodic counts tr(A^k), Artin-Mazur zeta) were motivated before computation by recognized programs (entropy-rigidity, Williams shift-equivalence, Krieger embedding); n=3 is the standard first splitting window (genuine entropy splitting absent at n<=2), k<=6 and enclosures fixed in advance. Values are not known or mechanically implied: distinct values, collisions, and gaps require computation over all types (e.g. 16-class golden-ratio collision across 3 charpolys sharing x^2-x-1; rho-gap ~0.0373; h-gap ~0.0186). A future researcher can reasonably need the precise facts as a citable benchmark for non-conjugacy discriminants and embedding tests. This is not a textbook restatement (formulas disclaimed), mere parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration: collision structure and extremal gaps give mathematical interpretation, and certification strengthens but does not substitute for the table. Maximal witness log 3 alone would be trivial, but draft explicitly makes the full table plus collisions/gaps the claim.
